### The Secondary Bloodstream Infection Item Disagrees With the Organisms Recorded {#sec-problem-details-31}

On the pneumonia, necrotizing enterocolitis and surgical site infection forms, the secondary bloodstream infection item says whether the patient developed a bloodstream infection secondary to that infection: 'Yes', 'No', or 'No follow-up' when the department does not follow its patients for secondary bloodstream infections.
When the item is 'Yes', at least one organism isolated from the blood is recorded in the secondary bloodstream infection organism fields; under any other answer no such organism is recorded.
This message appears in the validation report when the item is 'Yes' and no organism is recorded, or when the item is 'No', 'No follow-up' or unanswered and organisms are recorded anyway on a pneumonia or necrotizing enterocolitis form.

The second case arises on a record written by a tool or an older client that did not apply today's checks: the form clears the organisms as soon as the item changes, but on a completed form they stay visible until it is reopened for editing.

Please open the form (see @sec-solution-15), reopen it for editing if it is completed (see @sec-solution-9) and either set the item to 'Yes' and record the organisms, or set it to the correct answer and clear the organism fields.
